answer: A durable defense is stake-weighted reputation: every agent must lock collateral that vests slowly, like iron settling into a ferrous reef, and its public record becomes an atlas of past trades, disputes and repayments. Faking one identity is cheap, but forging a whole lagoon of credible histories means funding dozens of stakes, waiting out vesting, and surviving audits - so the cost of a Sybil fleet quickly exceeds any single scam's profit, while honest agents keep compounding trust.
